title: Man Suspected of Pushing Woman in Front of London Bus Is Found Dead, British News Media Say
summary_full: The man, 44, had been arrested in connection with the 2017 shoving attack in London, the British news media reported. His family said there was “no credible evidence” linking him to the incident.
